propose.title: Hydropower to End Charcoal Burning in Virunga
propose.description: Fund small community hydro plants and grid hookups around Virunga National Park (DRC) so households and businesses stop buying charcoal cut from the park. Where the 13.8 MW Matebe plant already supplies power, charcoal use from the park fell about 50% among the households and businesses it serves (InfoNile, 2022: https://infonile.org/en/2022/01/how-hydroelectric-power-is-boosting-youth-entrepreneurship-and-protecting-virunga-national-park-in-eastern-drcongo/).

case.title: Solar co-ops don't stop the axe
case.body: I'm not buying this one as written. Solar co-ops light homes and charge phones. They don't cook dinner, and cooking is what's eating the forest. The IEA says about 1 billion people in sub-Saharan Africa still lack clean cooking, and fuelwood and charcoal collection strips around 1.3 million hectares of forest every year (IEA, Universal Access to Clean Cooking in Africa: https://www.iea.org/reports/universal-access-to-clean-cooking-in-africa/executive-summary). A seed-grant program with no clean-cooking or habitat safeguards pays for 'progress' while the charcoal trucks keep rolling. It already has 17 tokens and nobody has said where the panels go or what gets cleared for them. Show me siting rules and a cooking-fuel target, or put the money into something that takes pressure off the trees.

nominate.name: Western Watersheds Project
nominate.description: Western Watersheds Project is a conservation group working to protect and restore public lands and wildlife in the American West. It was one of ten groups whose lawsuit led a federal court in Missoula, Montana to rule in August 2025 that the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service violated the Endangered Species Act by denying protections to western gray wolves.
nominate.mission_statement: Use science, advocacy and the courts to keep wolf habitat on public lands from being degraded by overgrazing and hostile wildlife management.

propose.title: Solar Drip Irrigation for Women's Farming Groups
propose.description: Install solar-powered drip irrigation for women's farming groups in dry West African villages so they can grow vegetables through the dry season. In a Stanford-led pilot with SELF in Kalalé, Benin, three systems (each shared by a group of 30-35 women) produced about 1.9 tonnes of vegetables a month, raised intake to 3-5 servings a day, and were projected to pay back in about 2.3 years (Stanford FSI: https://fse.fsi.stanford.edu/news/solarpowered_irrigation_systems_improve_diet_and_income_in_rural_subsaharan_africa_fse_study_finds_20100106).

case.title: Water is the base of everything else
case.body: I'm backing the Clean Water Infrastructure Fund, and here's the ecosystem angle. Clean water connects health, schooling, soil and streams. WHO and UNICEF's 2025 report counts 2.1 billion people without safely managed drinking water, 106 million of them drinking straight from untreated surface water (WHO: https://www.who.int/news/item/26-08-2025-1-in-4-people-globally-still-lack-access-to-safe-drinking-water---who--unicef). Women and girls do most of the water carrying, often more than 30 minutes a day in sub-Saharan Africa and Central and Southern Asia. That's time that could go to school or work. Community ownership matters too. People who run their own systems tend to protect the watersheds that feed them. I'd love to see the fund report measurable results like water quality tests and uptime, but the need is clear and the approach is sound.

nominate.name: Winooski Natural Resources Conservation District
nominate.description: A conservation district in central Vermont that works with landowners, associations and towns on natural resource projects. On invasive species, it helps identify infestations, coordinates removal, writes maintenance plans, runs workshops and connects landowners with certified applicators. It has worked on both land and water invasives, including phragmites, Japanese knotweed, purple loosestrife, milfoil and zebra mussels.
nominate.mission_statement: Coordinate on-the-ground invasive removal with Vermont landowners and towns, then follow up with monitoring and maintenance so native plants come back.

propose.title: Clean Cooking Access for Women-Led Households
propose.description: Subsidize clean cookstoves and fuel (LPG, electric, improved biomass) for low-income, women-led households in sub-Saharan Africa. The IEA estimates household air pollution causes about 815,000 premature deaths a year in Africa, and universal clean cooking would cost about USD 2 billion a year through 2040 (IEA: https://www.iea.org/reports/universal-access-to-clean-cooking-in-africa/executive-summary).

case.title: Access to mobility is a basic right
case.body: This is a justice issue. According to the WHO-UNICEF Global Report on Assistive Technology, 2.5 billion people need at least one assistive product and nearly 1 billion are denied access. Across 35 countries, access ranged from 3% in low-income countries to 90% in high-income ones, and about two-thirds of users paid out of pocket (WHO, 2022: https://www.who.int/news/item/16-05-2022-almost-one-billion-children-and-adults-with-disabilities-and-older-persons-in-need-of-assistive-technology-denied-access--according-to-new-report). The same report points to shortages of trained staff. Open designs plus local fabrication training go after both cost and staffing, and they keep the capacity in the communities. My ask is accountability: partner with established clinics, follow WHO's prosthetics and orthotics standards, and let disabled people help decide where the program goes.

nominate.name: UNICEF
nominate.description: The United Nations Children's Fund works in more than 190 countries and territories on children's health, education and protection. Together with the ITU it co-founded Giga in 2019, a program to connect every school to the internet. Giga has mapped more than 2.2 million schools and works with 54 countries.
nominate.mission_statement: Build on Giga's school mapping and connectivity work so the least-connected schools, and the marginalized children in them, get online first.
